create_CompatValidator: create a CompatValidator instance to validate numpy-compatible args and kwargs against default parameter values
validate_argmin_max: validate argmin and argmax numpy compatibility by checking out parameter defaults and skipna handling
validate_argsort: validate argsort numpy compatibility by checking axis, kind, order, and stable parameter defaults
validate_stat_functions: validate statistical functions like sum, mean, median, prod against numpy default parameter signatures
validate_groupby_func: validate that numpy operations are not valid with groupby and raise UnsupportedFunctionCall
